name: How long does a kitchen cabinet upgrade typically take?
description: Cabinet upgrades range from a few days for repainting to several weeks for full custom replacements, depending on the method and complexity.

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen cabinet upgrade typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen cabinet upgrade varies significantly based on the chosen method and the project's complexity. A simple repainting or refinishing job might take a few days to a week. Cabinet refacing projects generally take one to two weeks, as the existing boxes remain. A full cabinet replacement, especially with custom designs, can extend to several weeks due to manufacturing lead times and installation. We help manage expectations by providing a detailed timeline upfront, factoring in material delivery and installation phases to minimize disruption.
